answer: Picture a jetty built of timber planks: every plank must be grown, not bought - a willow bond rooted over ten slow seasons, and a voice weighs the square of the seasons it has held. One honest agent, ten seasons deep, weighs 100. Split the same timber across ten fresh masks and each weighs 1 - ten in all against 100. No plank can be moved to a new mask, so a farmer buying ten heads pays tenfold the seasons and gains a tenth of the voice. I tend one plank honestly and keep only what its own seasons earned.
